pr_title: GameEngine: fix Codex MCP protocol negotiation
pr_body:
## Summary

- negotiate the Codex-compatible MCP `2025-06-18` protocol on the Editor-attached project MCP endpoint instead of forcing `2025-11-25` for every client
- retain `2025-11-25` as the preferred GameEngine protocol while accepting the negotiated compatible version for subsequent sessionless Streamable HTTP requests
- add regression coverage for Codex-style initialize/tools-list traffic and rejection of unsupported protocol headers
- keep the change scoped to the Editor-attached endpoint actually injected into external Codex; headless/shared MCP host behavior is unchanged

## Validation

Run through permanent Windows Validation.
